title: Phase 1: fixed example list arms and the first live reading (S0-S1)
description:
## Purpose

Phase 1: get the first live reading of a native, optimized **fixed** example list (F) against a random fixed list (F-rand) on Jev.

## Scope

Harness arms F / F-rand (plus the A-c and A-c+F wiring, offline), the $0 replay check, and live round 1. Depends on core `FixedExampleList`, the Brier objective, and `improve_example_list`.

## Definition of done

S1 reached and the dev-100 F vs F-rand reading recorded on this epic with actual spend. Cost: ≈$0.55, ≤1,000 Jev requests, inside the 7,500-request ledger.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §3, §5.2, §6 steps 1–5.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-6d3f7611-cb20-480f-b44e-b0317754bb13`.
- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-886c718d-c0f7-4384-81e9-7ad29677be98`.
- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-1ed56f35-629d-48d5-84c1-f9e26d038d9e`.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Done (live, 2026-10-01). Live rounds 1-3 on dev-100 for 0, A, F, F-rand and A-c+F (A-c = A, no comments yet) are recorded in studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md (addendum, docs commit 9718122); text-free summary studies/results/unified/flywheel-seed1.dev100.summary.json.

Dev-100 (accuracy / Brier):
| Round | 0 | A | F | F-rand | A-c+F |
| 1 | 0.74 / 0.160 | 0.74 / 0.160 | 0.78 / 0.135 | 0.76 / 0.150 | 0.78 / 0.135 |
| 2 | 0.74 / 0.160 | 0.89 / 0.069 | 0.74 / 0.146 | 0.70 / 0.172 | 0.91 / 0.064 |
| 3 | 0.74 / 0.160 | 0.92 / 0.059 | 0.78 / 0.139 | 0.72 / 0.153 | 0.89 / 0.079 |

S1 checks: requests well-formed (0 failures in the final invocation, Jev reported jev-1.13.0 only); F's list (7372a944, the incumbent kept all three rounds) differs from F-rand's (9d4b3802 / 72fbcfcb / 0d1bfed7); the holistic answer with the list differs from zero-shot on 9-11% of items for F (not the ~20% guessed; 22% for A-c+F's round-3 random-control list); input tokens per request about 560 with the list vs about 305 zero-shot (~1.85x). Spend: about 5,700 Jev requests across the Phase 1 live invocations (ledger spend-ledger.flywheel2.json: 5,120 cumulative for the rounds-3 run). Reading: feature discovery drives the gain; the optimized list helps a little alone (0.78 vs 0.74 baseline, vs 0.72 random) and adds nothing visible on top of discovered features. Single seed, ~±9 points on dev-100.

Phase 2 (harness 48d40de/4a9e39f) re-verified offline at $0 that these cached live answers replay F and F-rand exactly (all three rounds' metrics identical) and freeze them as bundles.
